spsqrt_lane.basis: pre-layout: ORFS yosys/abc at CORNER=WC, OpenSTA SS RVT libs (setup, 60 ps) and FF RVT libs (hold, 25 ps), ideal clock

route.top: ot_dsrom_su_spsqrt_lane1 (one ot_hdc_v41x_softplus_s PCUT 1 lane + in register)

*.ffn.softplus_sqrt.source: ot_dsrom_su_spsqrt (24 lanes of ot_hdc_v41x_softplus_s #(PCUT 1), 0.9 GHz serial domain (measured CDC charged on its edges), at the router field's output root: 2 in + 2 out wire stages) 132 cycles first raw row in -> the die's 96 scores out (4 beats), exact on all 40 layers x 384 rows of the 1M token + 200016 stress inputs (sim.json)

floor.why_below: the short unit (ot_hdc_v41x_softplus_s) computes each golden rounding with fused correctly-rounded steps (Horner step 5, sqrt 16, t/(t+2) 19 from the exp Horner result), depth 124 at 0.9 GHz vs the 216-cycle op-by-op chain at 1.2 GHz; same bits (exhaustive 2^32 in results/rtl/w11_softplus_short.json, plus all 40 layers here)
floor.residual: lane latency 128 (in 2 + 124 + out reg 1 + out 2 - 1) + 3 stream beats + 1; re-pipelining the short unit for 1.2 GHz would save ~0.01 us a layer (<0.1% AR): not pursued

default: opt-in: applied only in the recovery baseline; the stream unit's side pipe and ot_hdc_select_tree are unchanged
note: 1.2 GHz variants do not close: the serial f12 lane screens -431.2 ps at 833 ps (fsqrt, fdiv, exp glue; screens/r1_lane0_f12_833_FAIL.json), the short lane -245.0 ps at 833; the short lane closes 1.111 ns ROUTED (SS +17.0 / FF +3.74 ps), so the unit runs in the 0.9 GHz serial domain at the router field root and the composition charges the measured CDC on its two edges. Bias fold (ot_dsrom_su_bias_select, exact 40/40 layers + 4,000 random, 48 cyc) REJECTED: worth ~0.09 us a layer (<1% alone) and its in-context f12 adder screens -170.7 / -46.2 (keep) / -85.4 (LA 5, keep) ps at 833 ps; ffn.bias stays on the SU. Composed (this lever alone on main 620.078 us): AR 1,612.7 -> 1,643.0 tok/s (+1.88%), MTP 4,462.1 -> 4,528.9 (+1.50%). Area: 24 lanes x 21,248 um2 cell = 0.51 mm2 (extent ~0.71 mm < 748 um reach: the 2 in / 2 out wire stages are conservative).
